notes.title: Engine and Achievement update
notes.content:
Engine Update

The engine has been updated to the latest version and is now running .NET6. 

Achievements Update

The achievements in the game were meant to be deisgned with a nice flow of simple and harder achievements, but somewhere in the process ended up with only hard or long achievements.  I am glad to say achievements have got a thorough reworking, and now flow better, but there are still some fiendishly difficult awards hiding in there.

notes.title: Additional Launguages Added.
notes.content: Added support for Norwegian, Swedish and Portuguese languages.

notes.title: Added Brazilian language support
notes.content: Added Brazilian translations for the game.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content: A small update to fix an occasional crash when resizing screen on launch.

notes.title: Snaaker & Friends Launch Announcement
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39153238/3a5801bb5aa72795835ad60ec7a72b7187dc2164.png

Snakes Away!

The moment the world has waited so long for has finally arrived.  The ultimate 3D game of snakes and balls has been unshackled.  The Snaaker has been freed.  

A big thank you to those who have helped me test the game and a big welcome to the new players who venture into the world of Snaaker & Friends, I hope you like what you find.
